name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project has a completed Definitive Feasibility Study and all key permits in hand, with the company transitioning from exploration to development and targeting first production in 2029. The company also holds an earn-in option with Teck on the La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan province, Argentina.
